messages:
Mia: quick draft — want to lock 3 core visuals for the benchmark launch and a tight inbound mapping. Goal: make latency vs unit-cost intuitive for product teams, give a short webinar hook, and map leads to the right trial. quick votes?

Raj: liking a 3-visual approach. suggest naming them: 1) Latency Budget Landscape, 2) Request Economics Waterfall, 3) SLA Fallback Story. each should map to an ask (trial, bench, enterprise).

Claire: agree. a couple nitpicks: use log-scale on cost axis for slide 1 (large model skew), show p50 + p95 latency bands, and annotate a clear 'sweet spot' region where latency <200ms & cost < $0.12/1k tokens. keep labels short.

Mia: good. rough chart spec for designers — paste into figma:
```
chart 1 (Latency Budget Landscape)
- x: median latency (ms) (linear)
- overlay: shaded p95 band
- y: cost per 1k tokens (USD) (log scale)
- points: hosted model variants, dedicated small/quantized variants, private-optimized variants
- annotation: "sweet spot: <200ms, <$0.12/1k"

chart 2 (Request Economics Waterfall)
- start: raw token cost (baseline)
- subtract: batching, prefix cache hits, KV cache reuse, quantization delta
- end: realized $/1k tokens
- callout: typical savings range for retrieval-heavy vs prompt-only

chart 3 (SLA Fallback Story)
- simple flow: route by policy -> primary model -> failure? -> fallback to quantized variant -> still meets latency SLO? show % cost lift for fallback
```

Frank: webinar title ideas: "Benchmarks that don't cheat: real workloads, real economics" or shorter: "Latency x Cost: The Real Tradeoffs". For a 30min slot, we should do 3 quick demos: chart walk, short config walkthrough (batching/cache), and a customer vignette.

Claire: inbound routing checklist (for growth):
- form field: workload type (chat, summarization, rerank, embeddings)
- checkbox: latency sensitive / compliance required / PoC / procurement ready
- auto-route: latency sensitive -> dedicated trial + hands-on SDR; compliance -> private eval + AE; PoC -> hosted credit + self-serve playbook
- tag leads with chart slice they care about (e.g., "high-throughput rerank").

Mia: love that. short landing copy drafts: "See how inference choices affect your latency and per-request bill — real traces, clear tradeoffs. Compare your workload in 5 minutes." CTA: "Compare my workload" (leads -> intake form above).

Raj: small UX ask — add a tiny interactive on the landing: slider for token mix (prompt vs context vs generation) that updates waterfall numbers. good gating for demos.

Devbot: attaching latest perf CSV from last internal run: https://redwood-internal/perf/bench-2026-02.csv (will expire in 7 days).

Opsbot: FYI the perf CSV includes per-route p50/p95, cost-estimates at three quantization configs, and regional deltas. use "region" filter for APAC vs US.

Mia: action items: 1) Claire — make figma frames w/ annotations from code block (due EOD Friday). 2) Raj — prototype slider interaction + wire for intake form (due next Wed). 3) Frank — finalize webinar title + 3-demo script (due Tue). 4) Growth — map routing tags to SDR flows and UTM. I'll assemble short copy for landing and the 3 chart tooltips.

Claire: noted. will ping with first frames later today. :white_check_mark:

Frank: will sketch demo script and share next week. :thumbsup:

Mia: thanks all — this feels like a good, tight story. If we keep visuals crisp we can A/B test two hooks (economics-first vs latency-first) in the hero.

Raj: +1 to AB. also recommend a short one-liner for sales: "Get consistent latency and half the per-request cost — here's how."

Mia: perfect. closing thread — will post a working deck link when Claire uploads. :rocket:
